free_tier.stated: The free plan is gone from the pricing page. The published plans are 'Team USD 150/component per month' with 'Infrastructure quota (soft limits) CPU - 25 RAM - 128GB Storage - 500GB Network - 500GB', 500 builds and 500 deployments a month, and 'Enterprise - Custom'. The only free route is 'Start 2 Week Free Trial'.

retention.stated: there is no perpetual allowance: the trial is a 14-day clock, and after it a component costs USD 150 a month.
